title: What Does God Require?
question: If God has shown us what is good, what are the three things He asks of us in return?
blurb: God strips it all down to three simple, weighty words: do justice, love mercy, walk humbly with Him.

nodes.content: If God has shown us what is good, what are the three things He asks of us in return?

nodes.verseText: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.

Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin. But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
“This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Administer true justice. Show loving devotion and compassion to one another.
